name: lightning_indexer_kernel_wmma
algorithm: Lightning attention Q*K^T indexer using WMMA/Tensor Core. Multi-warp cooperation with shared memory tiles for Q, K (quantized/fp16), and QK results. Complex inner loops over WMMA tiles.

reference.notes: llama.cpp CPU (ggml) backend produces the reference output

notes: WMMA version not ported — Intel Arc GPU WMMA (joint_matrix) path deferred. Vec path covers all types.

unit_test.details: All 24/24 lightning_indexer tests pass for F16+Q4_0. Additional types to be added to vec kernel.
